data.name: Removall Carbon
data.description: Removall Carbon is a developer and investor in high-integrity, nature-based projects that remove CO₂ from the atmosphere, with a portfolio of over 150 projects focused on reforestation, mangrove restoration, agroforestry, improved cookstoves, and clean water access. In April 2025 the company formed Summit Removall, a joint venture with Sumitomo Corporation, whose first investment is the MOZBLUE mangrove restoration project in Mozambique developed with Blue Forest. In July 2025 Removall secured corporate debt financing from four leading French banks to accelerate growth.
